conventions.abstention_layer: first crossing at raw, development-padded, or calibrated interval; exact outward rounding, approve lower >= 0, reject upper < 0
conventions.fixed_overlap: each fixed procedure retains its own q; retrospective resolutions are not an executable selector or a guarantee for alternative actions under selector q
conventions.geometry: excess envelope span is hull width minus maximum individual width; decomposition is descriptive, not a causal attribution
conventions.independence: 100 paired blocks, three families; no p-values, new confidence bounds, threshold tuning, or iid-case inference
conventions.prediction: saved N16 development-padded width, mean over every draw within source then maximum across initial sources; failures and candidate attrition retain frozen penalties
conventions.realized_width: saved post-verification raw candidate envelope plus twice the frozen action development offset; no final q in either width reduction
conventions.selected_groups: selected cases differ in difficulty; action-group contrasts are not causal measurement effects
conventions.shared_baseline: same acquisition-only initial envelope plus twice stop development offset for every action, including negative realized gains
conventions.stage_difference: forecasts precede independent verification; observed widths include its candidate filtering. Their difference is descriptive, not a calibrated prediction-error test
conventions.zero_boundary: a raw interval ending exactly at zero still abstains unless its lower endpoint is zero or above
